question: When evolve compares two creatures, do I compare power to power and toughness to toughness?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you always compare power to power and toughness to toughness.
expected.answer: When comparing the stats of the two creature for evolve, you always compare power to power and toughness to toughness.

whyHard: Players think a creature with more total stats evolves the creature, even when neither stat is bigger.
